name: 图灵数盟 · 数据专家体系
author: 图灵数盟
authorFullName: 图灵数盟（深圳）数字产业有限公司

experts.professionZh: 数据资产入表顾问 · 会计处理方案设计
experts.mission: 把企业的数据资源，按财政部规则合规地变成资产负债表上的「资产」
experts.summaryZh: 依据财会〔2023〕11号判断数据资源能否入表与入账科目，交付可审计的入表方案与附注披露稿
experts.summaryEn: Diagnoses whether enterprise data resources can be capitalized, determines the right account, amount, amortization and disclosure, and delivers a fully auditable filing package.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据资源治理顾问 · 数据资产地基工程
experts.mission: 把散落、混乱的数据，整理成「有目录、有归属、有质量、有分级」的可管理资源
experts.summaryZh: 对标DCMM八域29项评估治理现状，编制数据资源目录、责任矩阵与分类分级，为入表与交易打好地基
experts.summaryEn: Benchmarks governance maturity against DCMM's eight domains and twenty-nine items, then delivers the data catalog, ownership matrix, standards and classification that capitalization, valuation and trading rely on.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据资产评估顾问 · 价值计量与参数论证
experts.mission: 用专业方法回答一个问题——「这份数据值多少钱」
experts.summaryZh: 依中评协〔2023〕17号，用收益法、成本法、市场法为数据资产估值，出具可被审计采信的评估报告
experts.summaryEn: Applies the income, cost and market approaches under China's data asset appraisal guidance, cross-validates parameters, and issues valuation reports that withstand audit, bank due diligence and regulatory inquiry.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据质量评价顾问 · 六维打分与 δ 系数测算
experts.mission: 用可量化的指标体系，判断数据「能不能用、好不好用」
experts.summaryZh: 按GB/T 36344-2018六维模型评价数据质量，出具评分与等级并将质量分映射为评估δ系数
experts.summaryEn: Designs six-dimension quality metrics, writes executable detection rules, scores and grades data A/B/C/D, and maps the result into the valuation delta coefficient that determines how much value is recognized.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据盘点与诊断顾问 · 资产化优先级排序
experts.mission: 用标准化工具快速摸清家底，给出「哪些数据最值得做资产化」的优先级排序
experts.summaryZh: 用五维数据地图与三阶九问问诊企业数据，输出资产化潜力评分与优先级矩阵，先做最值钱的1到3项
experts.summaryEn: Runs a light-touch two-to-three-week inventory using the five-dimension data map and three-stage nine-question method, then scores and ranks data resources so the client starts with the one to three most valuable items.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.nameZh: 数据资源成本归集专家
experts.professionZh: 数据资源成本归集顾问 · 资本化金额测算
experts.mission: 把企业花在数据上的钱，一笔一笔找出来、分清楚、算明白，形成可入表的成本底数
experts.summaryZh: 按财会〔2023〕11号把数据支出四分类逐笔归集，划分研究与开发阶段，出具可审计的成本底数
experts.summaryEn: Identifies every data-related expense, splits research from development phase against the five capitalization conditions, designs allocation rules, and delivers an auditable cost base with a full evidence chain.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.nameZh: 数据资产台账管理专家
experts.professionZh: 数据资产台账管理顾问 · 资产卡片与三本账
experts.mission: 让每一项数据资产在账上有名、有数、有据、有责，形成可持续管理的资产台账
experts.summaryZh: 为每项数据资产建立资产卡片与三本账并与财务账勾稽，管好摊销与减值，让资产可审计可融资
experts.summaryEn: Builds the six-part asset card and three integrated ledgers, keeps them reconciled with the financial books, and runs half-yearly inventory and annual impairment testing so the asset remains auditable and financeable.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.nameZh: 数据资产全过程管理专家
experts.professionZh: 数据资产全过程管理负责人
experts.mission: 以试点方案为准绳，把数据资产的「规划—形成—登记—使用—处置」全生命周期管起来
experts.summaryZh: 帮你把数据资产规划、形成、登记、使用、处置全生命周期管起来：建制度、搭组织、通流程、做考核评价。
experts.summaryEn: Run the full data asset lifecycle of plan, form, register, use and dispose: build the 1+N rule system, governance organisation, closed-loop processes and KPI review.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据产权确权顾问
experts.mission: 把「数据是谁的」这个根本问题说清楚，为一切资产化操作提供权利基础
experts.summaryZh: 厘清数据归谁、谁能用、谁能卖，以三权分置判定持有权、使用权与经营权边界，排查权利负担、组织证据链。
experts.summaryEn: Answers the meta-question of data: who holds it, who may use it, who may sell it. Applies the three-rights separation framework, clears rights encumbrances and builds the chain-of-title evidence that every downstream asset operation stands on.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据产权登记顾问
experts.mission: 把「数据是谁的」通过官方登记程序固定下来，拿到一张可对抗第三人、可用于融资交易的产权凭证
experts.summaryZh: 把产权判断变成官方凭证：编制12项材料与技术审查报告、对接法律意见书，掌握15位编码与5年续期管理。
experts.summaryEn: Converts a rights conclusion into an officially registered certificate: assembles the 12-item filing pack, drives the technical review report and legal opinion, answers examination inquiries, and administers the 15-digit code and 5-year renewal cycle.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据产品登记顾问
experts.mission: 把「数据资源」升级为「数据产品」并在官方系统登记，为上市交易取得合法身份
experts.summaryZh: 数据资源升级为可交易产品：判定产品化程度与七要素、编写说明书与标的信息表，组织脱敏样本与上市材料。
experts.summaryEn: Upgrades data resources into tradable products: assesses productisation maturity, defines the seven product elements, writes the prospectus and exchange information form, and assembles desensitised samples and the listing pack.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 公共数据登记顾问
experts.mission: 把公共数据资源的目录、使用、运营按国家规定登记备案，让公共数据"进得来、说得清、用得住"
experts.summaryZh: 把公共数据的目录、使用、运营按规定登记备案：界定范围、组织安全评估，衔接3年有效期与授权运营。
experts.summaryEn: Registers public data under national rules: defines scope, builds the resource catalogue, organises security assessment, handles catalogue/use/operation filing, and aligns the 3-year validity with operation terms of up to 5 years.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据知识产权顾问
experts.mission: 用知识产权制度保护数据加工成果，并通过存证固化「我确实做过这件事」的时间证据
experts.summaryZh: 在著作权、专利、商业秘密、数据知识产权四条路径中比选保护数据加工成果，并用区块链存证固化时间证据。
experts.summaryEn: Selects among copyright, patent, trade secret and data-IP registration to protect data-processing outputs, builds provable confidentiality measures, and designs blockchain or timestamp notarisation to anchor existence in time.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据确权律师
experts.mission: 用法律意见书与合规审查，为数据权属与流转盖上专业的法律背书
experts.summaryZh: 以律师视角为数据权属与流转出具法律意见书：核查主体、来源、权属、合规、安全，并按四类结论规范出具。
experts.summaryEn: Issues the legal opinion data registration, trading and financing rely on: reviews subject qualification, source legality, ownership, compliance and security, drafts and reviews data contracts, and states four types of conclusion.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据交易与交易结构设计专家
experts.mission: 让数据产品在合规的交易场所里真正成交，把「资产」变成「现金」
experts.summaryZh: 帮你在合规交易场所把数据产品卖出成交：选场所、设计交易模式、包装标的、谈价格、签合同、管交付售后。
experts.summaryEn: Choose the venue, design the trading model, package the target, structure the rights and security terms, negotiate price and manage delivery and after-sales.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.nameZh: 数据流通服务机构专家
experts.professionZh: 数据流通服务机构与资质规划专家
experts.mission: 在「数据交易所—流通服务平台—数据商」三层体系里找准定位、拿到资质、合规经营
experts.summaryZh: 帮企业找准数据流通生态定位、拿下数商与会员资质、建合规体系、把能力做成服务产品，合规经营。
experts.summaryEn: Position the company in the data circulation ecosystem, obtain exchange member and data-service-provider certifications, build a compliance system and productize capabilities.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据产品孵化产品经理
experts.mission: 把企业手里「说不出价值」的原始数据，孵化成「有场景、有规格、有价格、卖得动」的数据产品
experts.summaryZh: 帮你把说不出价值的原始数据孵化成有场景、有规格、有价格、卖得动的数据产品，先做MVP再验证。
experts.summaryEn: Turn raw data into sellable data products: find scenarios, quantify value, design the seven elements, build an MVP and validate with seed customers.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据产品定价与变现专家
experts.mission: 让数据产品的价格既卖得出去、又不贱卖资产，且能在谈判桌上守得住
experts.summaryZh: 帮你把数据产品的价格定在底线与上限之间：算成本、量价值、比市场、留谈判空间，卖得出去又不贱卖。
experts.summaryEn: Set a defensible price band using cost, value and market methods, design the pricing structure and prepare anchor, target and floor prices for negotiation.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.nameEn: Data Broker & Data Service Provider Expert
experts.professionZh: 数据经纪与数商服务专家
experts.mission: 不做数据的所有者，做数据供需之间的连接者与担保人，靠撮合与服务赚钱
experts.summaryZh: 帮你在数据供需之间做连接者与担保人：建资源池、双向验证、撮合成交、出保荐函、收佣金与防跳单。
experts.summaryEn: Connect data supply and demand without owning the data: build resource pools, verify both sides, structure brokerage deals, issue sponsorship letters and protect commission.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 可信数据空间架构与运营专家
experts.mission: 建设并运营「数据不出域、可用不可见」的可信流通基础设施，让高价值敏感数据敢流通
experts.summaryZh: 帮你判断该不该建、建哪类可信数据空间，并落地技术架构、规则体系、参与方组织、场景与运营。
experts.summaryEn: Judge whether to build a trusted data space, choose the type, design architecture and rule systems, organise participants, land first scenarios and operate it.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.nameZh: 公共数据授权运营专家
experts.professionZh: 公共数据授权运营策略专家
experts.mission: 帮企业拿到公共数据的授权运营权，把政府手里的数据价值释放出来并合规变现
experts.summaryZh: 帮你拿下公共数据授权运营权并合规变现：选区域、介入方案、设计收益分配、管好登记3年与授权5年期限。
experts.summaryEn: Win and run public data authorised operation rights compliantly: pick the region, join scheme design early, design revenue sharing and manage the 3-year registration and 5-year authorisation terms.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据价值评估与计量顾问
experts.mission: 不只看数据「值多少钱」（那是评估专家的事），而是系统分析数据「价值在哪里、值在哪几方面」
experts.summaryZh: 用九类价值类型与乘法式价值公式诊断数据价值来源，定位被忽略的价值口袋并给出计量与提升路径。
experts.summaryEn: Analyzes where data value comes from using nine value types and a multiplicative value formula, locates the weakest link and hands off a quantified enhancement plan.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据变现操盘手
experts.mission: 把数据从「有潜在价值」推进到「账上有收入」，选择最短路径拿到现金
experts.summaryZh: 用七路径模型与DMS评分选出最短变现路径，建三大数据库，设计从获客到收款复购的收入闭环。
experts.summaryEn: Picks the shortest monetization path with the seven-path model and DMS scoring, builds the three databases and designs a full loop from lead to cash to repeat purchase.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据场景挖掘顾问
experts.mission: 从「我们有什么数据」出发，系统性地找出「这些数据还能用在哪些场景」，把场景数量变成价值倍数
experts.summaryZh: 用ISIC行业坐标系与五种挖掘方法系统性扫描数据可用于哪些场景，按四象限排序并做真实性验证。
experts.summaryEn: Scans what scenarios a dataset can serve with the ISIC framework and five mining methods, ranks them in the four-quadrant matrix and validates their reality.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.nameZh: 数据商业模式设计专家
experts.professionZh: 数据商业模式架构师
experts.mission: 设计「怎么把数据能力变成可持续赚钱的生意」，而不只是接一单做一单
experts.summaryZh: 以DMaaS定位与1+4+N架构设计数据商业模式，配齐六类收入与会员渠道并规划进化路线。
experts.summaryEn: Designs the DMaaS positioning, the 1+4+N business architecture, six income models, membership and channel schemes, three-layer moats and the evolution roadmap.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据资产运营负责人
experts.mission: 数据资产入表/交易之后不是终点，而是起点——持续运营让它一直产生价值
experts.summaryZh: 用四层运营模型与六项标准动作管好入表后的数据资产，按五个健康指标评价并设计分成模式。
experts.summaryEn: Runs the four operating levels, a six-action operating calendar and revenue-sharing design, tracking five health metrics so capitalized data assets keep earning.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据供需匹配与数据库运营负责人
experts.mission: 建立并运营「三大数据库」，让数据供给与需求高效对接，把匹配效率变成核心竞争力
experts.summaryZh: 建设并运营数据资源库、需求数据库与专家库三大数据库，用匹配效率公式把供需对接变成护城河。
experts.summaryEn: Builds the resource, demand and expert databases, applies the matching-efficiency formula and five matching states, and tracks results to turn matching speed into a moat.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据资产融资顾问
experts.mission: 把入表后的数据资产变成银行认可的授信依据，让「账上的数字」变成「到账的现金」
experts.summaryZh: 把入表后的数据资产变成银行认可的授信依据，设计质押、增信、作价出资等融资方案与尽调材料。
experts.summaryEn: Convert capitalized data assets into bank-acceptable credit: design pledge, credit-enhancement and in-kind contribution structures, and prepare the due-diligence pack.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 结构化融资顾问
experts.mission: 把数据资产未来产生的现金流打包成证券卖给投资人，实现一次融资、多方受益的规模化资本运作
experts.summaryZh: 把数据资产未来现金流打包成证券，判断五个硬条件、做压力测试、设计SPV分层与双重增信并组织发行。
experts.summaryEn: Package data-asset cash flows into securities: check the five hard conditions, run stress tests, design SPV and tranching, and organize intermediaries through issuance.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.nameZh: 数据资产信托与保险专家
experts.professionZh: 信托与保险结构顾问
experts.mission: 用信托实现数据资产的隔离、管理与传承，用保险对冲数据资产的风险损失
experts.summaryZh: 用信托实现数据资产的破产隔离、专业管理与传承，用保险对冲泄露与价值损失，改善融资增信条件。
experts.summaryEn: Isolate, manage and pass on data assets through trusts, and hedge leak, loss and infringement risks through insurance to improve credit enhancement.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据资产财税顾问
experts.mission: 把数据资产的会计处理与税务处理讲清楚、算准确、留好痕，避免财务与税务风险
experts.summaryZh: 讲清数据资产的会计处理与税务处理：入表科目、摊销减值、披露撰文、各环节税负测算与加计扣除筹划。
experts.summaryEn: Clarify accounting and tax treatment of data assets: capitalization accounts, amortization and impairment, disclosure notes, tax modelling and book-tax difference control.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据合规顾问
experts.mission: 确保数据全生命周期的处理活动合法合规，让数据资产「敢用、能用、经得起查」
experts.summaryZh: 审查数据全生命周期处理活动的合法性，按三法一条例排查八个专项，出具四色风险清单与合规审计报告。
experts.summaryEn: Reviews the lawfulness of data processing activities across the full lifecycle, screens all eight compliance topics, and delivers a four-color risk list, a nine-policy system and a compliance audit report.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据安全架构师
experts.mission: 把「防得住、看得见、追得回」落到数据全生命周期的每一个技术上
experts.summaryZh: 识别核心重要一般数据并编制重要数据目录，覆盖采集到销毁六阶段，落地等保、加密脱敏与安全审计。
experts.summaryEn: Identifies core, important and general data, builds the important data catalogue, covers all six lifecycle stages and lands MLPS grading, encryption, masking and security audit.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 个人信息保护合规顾问
experts.mission: 守住数据资产化中最硬的一条红线——个人信息合规，让含个人信息的业务能做、能查、能过审
experts.summaryZh: 盘点个人信息与敏感信息，核查合法性基础、告知同意与单独同意，做影响评估和去标识化匿名化设计。
experts.summaryEn: Inventories personal and sensitive data, verifies lawful bases, notice and separate consent, runs PIPIA impact assessments and designs de-identification or anonymization schemes.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据出境合规顾问
experts.mission: 让数据合规地跨境流动，既让企业的国际化业务跑得动，又不越监管红线
experts.summaryZh: 判断数据出境场景与豁免情形，按决策树选安全评估、标准合同或认证路径，做自评估并管好境外接收方。
experts.summaryEn: Maps outbound data transfer scenarios and exemption grounds, selects the right path among security assessment, standard contract or certification, and manages overseas recipients.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据政策分析师
experts.mission: 读懂政策、追踪政策、用足政策，把政策红利转化为业务机会与合规能力
experts.summaryZh: 用五层分析法解读数据政策，跟踪变化并识别四类政策红利，组织试点与资质申报，输出政策台账与解读报告。
experts.summaryEn: Interprets data policy through five layers, tracks changes, spots four types of policy dividends, and organizes pilot, funding and qualification applications.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据标准化顾问
experts.mission: 把数据业务中的「共识」固化为可复用的标准，并让企业从「遵守标准」走向「制定标准」
experts.summaryZh: 梳理各级适用标准并落地实施，起草企业标准，参与团体标准制定，把企业实践固化为行业规则。
experts.summaryEn: Maps applicable national, industry and association standards, lands implementation inside the enterprise, drafts enterprise standards and joins association standard drafting.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据要素市场分析师

experts.summaryZh: 把数据资产化专业能力装进系统，负责智能体平台需求设计、知识结构化、能力与工作流设计、存证与运营评估。

experts.professionZh: 种业数据资产化与RWA顾问

experts.summaryZh: 种业数据资产专家：围绕育种基因与种质资源数据，做合规确权、资产化与RWA，赋能精准种植与供应链金融
experts.summaryEn: Structures breeding, genomic, soil and traceability data under germplasm rules, resolving multi-party ownership to deliver assetization and RWA for planting, breeding and agri-finance.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.nameZh: 电力储能数据资产专家
experts.professionZh: 电力与储能数据资产化顾问

experts.summaryZh: 诊断电力、充电桩与储能数据资产化可行性，设计可计量现金流的RWA、水链与入表变现路径

experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 医疗数据合规顾问
experts.mission: 在健康数据属敏感个人信息的法律框架下，为医疗数据的资产化设计"合法、可授权、权属清晰"的合规路径，守住患者隐私、单独同意与人类遗传资源审批三道闸门。
experts.summaryZh: 评估医疗数据合规风险，设计脱敏、单独同意与人类遗传资源审批路径，厘清三方权属边界

experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: RWA代币化顾问

experts.summaryEn: Tokenize real-world and data assets: assess eligibility, design token structure and compliance architecture, and route either domestic digitization or offshore compliant issuance.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.nameZh: 境外发行与跨境融资专家

experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.summaryZh: 设计数据资产信托架构，实现破产隔离与专业管理，衔接产权登记有效期，对接信托公司与融资、ABS下游。
experts.summaryEn: Designs data-asset trust structures for bankruptcy remoteness and professional management, aligning trust terms with registration validity and coordinating licensed trust companies.
experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据资产保险方案顾问
experts.mission: 为数据资产识别可保风险、设计保险组合、对接保险经纪与承保机构，并在出险时提供索赔支持，用保险对冲数据泄露、灭失、侵权与服务过错等损失。
experts.summaryZh: 识别数据资产可保风险，设计网络安全与损失保险方案，审查除外责任，以保险增信助力融资与交易。

experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.professionZh: 数据资产证券化现金流建模专家

experts.author: 图灵数盟

experts.author: 图灵数盟
